title: Priority lattice: strategy for scoring roadmap items across cost & latency scenarios
creator: Nora Martinez
description:
Problem: Our existing RICE-style prioritization scores capture reach/impact/confidence/effort but miss multi-dimensional operational economics: different customers and workloads create distinct cost/latency tradeoff regimes. As a result, roadmap decisions can bias toward short-term feature velocity or optimistic latency assumptions that later increase unit cost or degrade SLAs for key customers.

Goal: Define and operationalize a ‘Priority Lattice’ — a repeatable scoring and simulation workflow that augments RICE with scenario-weighted cost and latency impact multipliers, producing an actionable ranked list and suggested rollout policy per initiative. The lattice must be understandable by PMs, quantifiable for Eng leads, and integrable with the Console metrics and release planning.

Approach Summary:
1) Scenario definition: create 3 canonical workload scenarios (Burst/Low-latency, Steady High-throughput, Regulated/Private) with associated token distributions, sequence length profiles, and target latency SLOs.
2) Base score: compute traditional RICE for each candidate item.
3) Operational multipliers: for each scenario, compute two multipliers — Cost Multiplier (expected $/1M tokens delta) and SLO Risk Multiplier (probability of violating p95 latency * severity factor).
4) Lattice aggregation: produce per-scenario adjusted scores (RICE * (1 / CostMultiplier) * (1 / (1 + SLO_Risk))) and surface both the aggregated ranking and scenario-specific rankings.
5) Simulation & sensitivity: run Monte Carlo draws across uncertainty distributions (effort, impact, cost delta) to produce percentile-ranked lists and an expected-value recommended rollout.

Acceptance criteria:
- Definition doc with canonical scenario profiles published (Confluence link included).
- Prototype spreadsheet that computes per-candidate lattice scores for a sample set of 30 roadmap items.
- A simulation harness (not production code) that demonstrates stability of top-10 picks under ±20% cost/effort uncertainty.
- PM and Eng lead sign-off on interpretability (two walkthroughs complete).
- Integration plan for adding lattice fields to Linear exports and Console initiative dashboards.

Deliverables:
- Confluence: "Priority Lattice — method and scenarios" (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RP/Priority+Lattice).
- Spreadsheet: candidate scoring + scenario sensitivity (Drive link).
- Short demo notebook and Monte Carlo harness (GitHub gist: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pm-tools/priority-lattice-prototype).
- Linear tags and template for future scoring.

Trade-offs and decisions:
- We will not replace RICE; lattice is an augmentation layer to preserve PM mental model.
- To keep scoring lightweight, cost multipliers use model-agnostic $/token deltas from Redwood Optimize recommendations rather than full infra TCO modeling. If a candidate has strong infra dependencies, add ENG cost review as an extra step.
- Chose three scenarios rather than more granular buckets to balance coverage vs. cognitive load; future work can parameterize additional customer profiles.

Next steps (Immediate):
- Finish scenario profiles (Assignee: Ethan) — due 2026-03-07 (in progress).
- Populate prototype spreadsheet with current roadmap candidates (Assignee: Nora) — due 2026-03-11 (in progress).
- Run initial simulation and prepare slide deck for GTM/strategy sync (Assignee: Ethan) — due 2026-03-15.

Links and artifacts:
- Confluence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RP/Priority+Lattice
- Prototype sheet: https://drive.google.com/priority-lattice-prototype
- Monte Carlo harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pm-tools/priority-lattice-prototype
- Related Linear references: PM-5172, PM-72300 (workflow examples)

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Teams may game cost estimates. Mitigation: require Eng estimate or Redwood Optimize delta as a required field; flag high-variance items for review.
- Risk: Lattice complexity could slow planning cycles. Mitigation: provide a one-click Linear export that pre-populates scenario fields and a short explainer video.

Owner notes: This ticket is intentionally scoped as a lightweight framework + prototype to be validated over one cycle before embedding in the long-term roadmap tooling. If initial feedback is positive, follow-up work will automate lattice scoring in the Console and expose scenario toggles for sales/customer discussions.
